description: List all Tailscale Services in your tailnet. Services provide stable MagicDNS names and virtual IPs, decoupled from individual devices. Note: this MCP has no create-service tool. The API documents its Service PUT as create-or-update, but tailscale_update_service sends only the fields you pass, so do not use it to create one. Use the update/delete/approval tools here once the service exists.
name: tailscale_list_services
title: List services
